_comment: Shared parity fixture for the render-region sentinel marker (epic #2421 / #2432). Consumed by crates/zfb-types/tests/render_region_marker_parity.rs (the canonical serializer in crates/zfb-types/src/render_region.rs), crates/zfb/src/commands/render_artifact.rs's parse_marker round-trip test, and the TS renderer-driven oracle in packages/zfb/src/__tests__/render-region-marker-cases.ts. Any drift between producers/consumers is caught by whichever side reads this file.

cases._note: HTML-escaped id (& -> &): renderers escape attribute values before this pass ever runs; parse_marker takes the id verbatim and does NOT un-escape it back to the original specifier — see render_artifact.rs's parse_marker doc comment for the full asymmetry rationale
